faq.q: How much GST can a first-time buyer get back on a new home in BC?
faq.a: Up to $50,000: together with the new housing rebate, the FTHB GST/HST rebate returns 100% of the GST on a new or substantially renovated home valued up to $1 million, is gradually reduced between $1 million and $1.5 million, and is not available at $1.5 million or more, for builder agreements entered into on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031.

faq.q: What happened to the old GST new housing rebate?
faq.a: It still exists on its own terms: generally 36% of the GST paid, to a maximum of $6,300, gradually reduced for homes priced or valued between $350,000 and $450,000, and unavailable at $450,000 or more.

faq.q: Can I use both the FHSA and the Home Buyers' Plan for the same home?
faq.a: Yes — the CRA states a person can make a qualifying FHSA withdrawal and withdraw under the Home Buyers' Plan for the same qualifying home, as long as all conditions are met at the time of each withdrawal; FHSA participation room in the first year the account is opened is $8,000.
